answer_2.quote: We adopt the following three metrics: (1) Exact Match (EM), which measures whether the predicted answer span is exactly the same as the golden answer span. (2) Token level F1 score (F1), which measures the token level overlap of the predicted answer span and the golden answer span. (3) Path Overlap Score (POS), which measures the overlap of the path from the root tag (<HTML>) to the deepest tag that contains the complete predicted answer span and that contains the complete golden answer span.
